subtitle: Lesson 10 · Distributed Training Infrastructure

code:
# Every GPU holds a COMPLETE copy of the model.
# Each GPU trains on a DIFFERENT data shard.
#
#   GPU0: full model  <- batch A
#   GPU1: full model  <- batch B
#   GPU2: full model  <- batch C
#
# After backward pass: AllReduce gradients across
# all GPUs -> every replica applies the SAME update.
caption: Requires the model to already fit, gradients and optimizer state included, on one GPU.

code:
# Tensor parallelism - split WITHIN a layer:
#   GPU0 holds half of a weight matrix's columns
#   GPU1 holds the other half
#   -> partial results combined per layer
#
# Pipeline parallelism - split ACROSS layers:
#   GPU0: layers 1-8   GPU1: layers 9-16
#   -> micro-batches flow stage by stage
caption: Used when the model itself doesn't fit on one GPU, no matter the batch size.
